name: Bobadilla del Campo (Spain)
description: A white cross throughout on a field quartered red at the upper hoist and lower fly, green at the lower hoist and blue at the upper fly.
history: The heraldic arms and the flag were officially approved on 24 August 2004 and published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León of 7 September 2004; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed by a full white cross at the centre whose arms are a fifth of the width of the flag, the upper hoist and lower fly rectangles being red, the lower hoist green and the upper fly blue.

features.role: cross throughout with arms a fifth of the width
